annotations.title: Compare the models of a category by price

description: The current models of a category with grouped models (graphics cards, processors, smartphones, consoles and others): the ones most versions are sold of, cheapest first, each with its lowest price in Polish stores now, the typical price of its versions, the number of versions and stores, and how its lowest price changed in the last 30 days. For questions like "which graphics card is the cheapest at each level" or "how much are RTX 5060, 5070 and RX 9070 now"; narrow the range with min_price_pln and max_price_pln. The category is a Polish name or slug, e.g. "karty-graficzne", "procesory", "smartfony", "konsole".

limit.description: How many models to return, cheapest first (default 15).

max_price_pln.description: Only models available for at most this many złoty.

min_price_pln.description: Only models whose lowest price is at least this many złoty.

name: compare_models
title: Compare the models of a category by price
